cloudSync.title: Settings Backup
cloudSync.description: Back up contacts, rules, Kanban cards and notes, and account metadata to WebDAV. Account passwords, OAuth tokens, and API keys can be included with a separate backup encryption password.
cloudSync.restoreNotice: Restoring without the backup encryption password is partial. Enter it to restore account passwords, OAuth tokens, and translation API keys when the backup contains them.

cloudSync.restoreSuccessWithSecrets: Backup restored with saved credentials. Existing OAuth connections and mailboxes with local data were preserved.
cloudSync.restoreConfirm: This will replace local rules, Kanban cards/notes, and contacts; merge account metadata; and restore encrypted secrets when present. Continue?
cloudSync.encryptionWarning: Note: regular settings are uploaded as JSON. Secrets are encrypted only when you enable the option below. Ensure your WebDAV server is trusted.
cloudSync.scopeNotice: WebDAV backup includes contacts, settings, rules, Kanban cards, and Kanban notes. Optional encrypted secrets include account passwords, OAuth tokens, and translation API keys. Message bodies and attachments are not included unless you saved text into a Kanban note.
cloudSync.includeSecrets: Include account passwords, OAuth tokens, and API keys
cloudSync.includeSecretsDesc: Secrets are encrypted with the password below before upload. You will need the same password to restore them on another device.
cloudSync.secretPassphrasePlaceholder: Required for backing up or restoring secrets
cloudSync.secretPassphraseRequired: Enter a backup encryption password to include account passwords, OAuth tokens, and API keys.
cloudSync.restoreSecretPassphraseRequired: This backup contains encrypted secrets. Enter the backup encryption password before restoring.
cloudSync.autoBackupFillFields: Fill in WebDAV credentials above to enable auto-backup.

about.title: About
about.description: A local-first desktop email client built with Rust and React. Mail, search index, and attachments stay on your device. No telemetry. Outbound traffic happens only when you use a feature that requires it: mail sync with your provider, translation, WebDAV settings backup, external message images you choose to load, or a manual GitHub update check.
about.features: Supports Gmail, Outlook, IMAP, and POP3 accounts. Includes Kanban board, full-text search, snooze, rules engine, built-in translation, and optional WebDAV settings backup.
